technique_name: Create an algorithm to determine the most efficient utilization of a virtual assistant
description: Our proposed algorithm for determining the most efficient utilization of a virtual assistant will analyze the tasks that the assistant can perform and the types of requests it receives. It will then assign tasks to the assistant based on the time it takes to complete each task and the associated urgency for completion.
